option.name: pattern
option.value: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$files = @('services.html','cases.html','blog.html','contacts.html','editions.html','bitrix.html','bitrix24.html','privacy.html'); foreach($f in $files) { $content = Get-Content $f -Raw -Encoding UTF8; $content = $content -replace '(?s)<body>\\s*<header.*?</nav>\\s*</nav>', '<body>'; $content = $content -replace '(?s)<footer.*?</footer>\\s*<script', '<script'; Set-Content $f $content -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline }; Write-Output 'Done'"
